description: The browser's own select in a Keyframery field: each new choice rises in out of a blur as the old one leaves upward, and the chevron dips.
moves: The chosen label rises in from below while the old one leaves upward.
The chevron dips once on every change.
The field gives a little under the pointer and springs back.
The focus ring starts out wide and closes onto the field on a spring.
keyboard: Changes the option, or moves through the open picker.
Jumps to an option starting with that letter.

propDocs.NativeSelect.wrapperClassName: Class names for the wrapper that holds the select, its label and the chevron. Pass `w-full` to fill the row.
propDocs.NativeSelect.valueClassName: Class names for the chosen option's label, drawn over the select.
propDocs.NativeSelect.icon: Your own chevron, in place of the default one.
propDocs.NativeSelectOption.value: The option's value. Required: it keys the option and is what `value` and `onValueChange` use.
